sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-11 and 2016-12-12, cardholder C09988 experienced unauthorized activity on card C09988-K1. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $59.67 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. The primary flagged transaction 3534820 ($59.67) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (Windows | UnknownOS | edge 16.0 | UnknownScreen) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 158 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Cardholder provided response for analyst_info under scenario denies'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C09988-K1 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer denial and definitive graph pattern signatures settled the verdict; further steps would not alter the defensive actions.
